headline: Egypt FRA hosts Oman financial officials to strengthen cooperation
summary: The Egyptian Financial Regulatory Authority hosted a delegation from Oman's Financial Services Authority to discuss financial supervision, stability, disclosure, and risk analysis cooperation.
why: Bilateral regulatory cooperation enhances cross-border supervisory standards and promotes best practices in emerging financial markets.

impacts.name: Egypt
impacts.why: Regulatory collaboration supports institutional alignment between the two nations.
